text: [43] cattārome bhikkhave puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ katame cattāro kodhagaru na saddhammagaru makkhagaru na saddhammagaru lābhagaru na saddhammagaru sakkāragaru na saddhammagaru ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ . cattārome bhikkhave puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ katame cattāro saddhammagaru na kodhagaru saddhammagaru na makkhagaru saddhammagaru na #1 ma. yu. ubhayassa hoti kovido . lābhagaru saddhammagaru na sakkāragaru ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasminti . kodhamakkhagaru bhikkhu lābhasakkāragāravo na te dhamme virūhanti sammāsambuddhadesite . ye ca saddhammagaruno vihaṃsu 1 viharanti ca te ve dhamme virūhanti sammāsambuddhadesiteti .
